For those not familiar, Insurgency is a first person shooter set in the middle east. Think U.S. vs Taliban. It's made using the source engine so even those of you with non-gaming laptops should be able to run it with decent frames.

The design theory of the game focuses on realism without sacrificing fun. There is no kill-cam, hit-markers, kill-feed, health bar, mini-map, or ammo counter. You remember your AK-47 has 30 rounds right? Because of the lack of UI, your teams success relies largely on your ability to communicate via mic or chat. Shit, there's a sniper. Did anyone see where the muzzle flash was? Because guns only take one or two bullets to kill, fire-fights are quick and brutal. And and without a kill-feed, when the bullets finally stop flying and you're still crouched behind cover, you're sitting there not sure if you actually got the kill, or if the enemy is still waiting for you to peek again.

tl;dr

I love this game and you should play it. It's even in the current Humble Bundle. Get it.
